nodes.name: EMA Crossover.md
nodes.summary: Wiki concept reference covering the Exponential Moving Average Crossover signal, including its definition, standard configuration (fast/slow period pairs), signal logic for bullish/bearish crossovers, calculation details, inputs/outputs, failure modes, and tradeoffs as a trend-following indicator used in the trading engine.

nodes.name: Options Trading.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive wiki concept page explaining options trading fundamentals — call/put options, premium, strike price, expiration, selling options for income generation, and the insurance analogy — with architecture role context, implementation notes, open questions, and future extension points for the paper-trading system.

nodes.name: Relative Volume Filter.md
nodes.summary: Wiki concept reference describing the Relative Volume Filter (RVOL) — a pre-trade liquidity gate that compares current volume to a rolling average and blocks entries when volume is below a configured threshold — covering configuration, signal logic, inputs, outputs, failure modes, and tradeoffs.

nodes.name: VWAP.md
nodes.summary: Wiki concept reference for Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), detailing its intraday calculation (cumulative TPV / cumulative volume), three roles in the system as trend filter, entry signal via VWAP crossover, and safety gate, plus inputs, outputs, failure modes, implementation notes, and tradeoffs.
